practice.title: SEO consulting built around decisions people can inspect
practice.body: VANTFLOW approaches SEO as a chain of accountable decisions. Findings need context, recommendations need a reason, and completed work needs a check. That keeps advice useful to the people who must approve, implement, or maintain it.
practice.history: The phrase “Copilot, not autopilot” belongs to the brand’s history: a reminder that tools can support judgement, but should not replace review or ownership.

principles.title: Evidence, reason, action, verification
principles.intro: Each stage answers a different question. Skipping one makes the recommendation harder to trust or maintain.

items.title: Evidence
items.body: Start with observable search, site, content, or business signals. Separate what is known from what still needs investigation.

items.title: Reason
items.body: Explain why the evidence matters, which constraint it reveals, and how it affects a priority rather than presenting an unexplained score.

items.title: Action
items.body: Translate the reasoning into a bounded next step with enough context for the person responsible for implementation.

items.title: Verification
items.body: Return to the original evidence after implementation. Confirm the intended change, record what remains, and revise the next action when needed.

delivery.title: English first, with reviewed French and Arabic planned
delivery.body: The current site and delivery material launch in English. French and Arabic are part of the planned delivery range, but those versions will only publish after human review.
delivery.review: This is a quality boundary, not a claim that the locales are already live. Meaning, terminology, and directionality need review before translated work represents the brand.
